title: Nitrogen cation HOMO
hints: Fill neutral N₂ using the early order.
Identify the highest occupied bond character.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Neutral N₂ has order 3. Its HOMO is bonding σ₂p. Removing one bonding electron lowers the order to 2.5.
statement:
What is the predicted bond order of $\ce{N2+}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Ionization removes a bonding σ₂p electron.
This would follow from removing an antibonding electron.
Removing a bonding electron changes order.
The cation loses one electron, not a pair.
